tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
More than 400 researchers call for stronger testing safeguards and global oversight of artificial intelligence systems, as confirmed by The Verge.
Nvidia announces plans to acquire a minority stake in Doctolib to boost artificial intelligence driven healthcare services, reported by 自由財經.
A former OpenAI employee was arrested for installing a spy device in San Francisco offices, which was detected by OpenAI's artificial intelligence, reported by FAZ.
Banking regulators warn of artificial intelligence driven risks, with attacks linked to Chinese artificial intelligence agents using Anthropic's Claude Code, still open per Gizmodo.
Nicolas Cage refused to sign an Amazon artificial intelligence waiver, fueling Hollywood artificial intelligence debate, reported by NBC News.
Free every hour.
